post.description: Bootstraps (or looks up) a session for a player's Bohemia ID, provisioning an account if needed. Always returns 200 — a blocked or not-whitelisted account is reported via the Status field, not an error.

Locks (blocks) an account: marks it Locked and disables its Keycloak user (blocks normal login; does not by itself block the Bridge's token-exchange grant — player-connected's status check is what actually prevents a new player token, see ARCHITECTURE.md §4.3). Idempotent — locking an already-locked account still returns 204.
Unlocks an account: re-enables its Keycloak user and marks it Active. Idempotent — unlocking an already-active account still returns 204.
Revokes a specific player-impersonation token by jti, e.g. on player disconnect.

get.description: Lists accounts, optionally filtered by a Bohemia ID substring match, for the admin accounts view.
Gets an account's currently assigned realm roles plus every role available to assign, minus Keycloak's own built-in roles.

put.description: Grants a Keycloak realm role to an account. Idempotent — assigning an already-held role still returns 204.

delete.description: Revokes a Keycloak realm role from an account. Idempotent — revoking a role it doesn't hold still returns 204.

post.description: Submits an account's whitelist application for the calling server.

get.description: Lists whitelist applications by status, for the review queue.

post.description: Marks an Open application as InReview. Idempotent if already InReview.
Approves an InReview application. Idempotent if already Approved.
Rejects an InReview application. Idempotent if already Rejected.

get.description: Gets a server's settings, defaulted if never configured.

patch.description: Partially updates a server's settings (e.g. WhitelistEnabled). Omitted fields are left unchanged.

post.description: Creates a new character for an account.

Starts a character's in-game session, e.g. when a player selects this character. Starting again while already active simply supersedes the previous session — there's no gameserver-crash/restart cleanup yet, so a stale active flag must not permanently block reselecting.

delete.description: Ends a character's in-game session, e.g. on player disconnect.

post.description: Opens a bank account for a character (Personal) or a company (Corporate) — provide exactly one of characterId/companyId.

get.description: Lists a character's personal bank accounts.
Lists a company's corporate bank accounts.
Lists a bank account's most recent transactions (deposits, withdrawals, transfers), newest first.

put.description: Deposits cash into a bank account.
Withdraws cash from a bank account, e.g. for an ATM.
Transfers cash to another bank account.
Debits a bank account and issues company shares to the acting character, atomically across the Banking and Companies modules.

post.description: Creates a new company; the founder becomes its first member.

get.description: Gets company details, including its members.

post.description: Adds a character as a member of a company.
Submits a character's application to join a company.

get.description: Lists a company's applications. Requires ManageMembers permission in the company.

put.description: Marks a pending application as InProgress. Requires ManageMembers permission in the company.
Accepts an application, adding the character as a member in the company's default position. Requires ManageMembers permission in the company.
Denies an application. Requires ManageMembers permission in the company.

post.description: Adds an item to the catalog.
Opens a shop for a character (Personal) or a company (Corporate) — provide exactly one of ownerCharacterId/ownerCompanyId matching ownerType.

get.description: Gets a shop and its active listings.

post.description: Adds a catalog item listing to a shop.

put.description: Updates a shop listing's price and stock.

post.description: Purchases a quantity of a shop listing, settling payment via Banking.
